plan: I will bid a fraction of my value in stage 1. This fraction should be less than 1, but high enough to win sometimes. I'll start with 0.75 as the fraction. So my bid will be 0.75 times my value. This should allow me to win some auctions at a reasonable price.

[I will bid a fraction of my value in the first round. This is because I want to win the auction at a price lower than my value. If I bid too high, I risk paying too much. If I bid too low, I risk exiting too early. A good starting point is to bid around 0.7 of my value.]

I will bid a fraction of my value in stage 1. This will allow me to participate in stage 2. If I bid too low, I risk exiting too early. If I bid too high, I risk paying too much if I win. I will bid 0.8 times my value. My value is $21, so my bid will be $21 * 0.8 = $16.8.
